I started making a game! It's inspired by Harvest Moon! Yay!
It's going to use LibGDX as the meat and potatoes of the game engine. I'm going to modify the parts I need to so I can implement the features I would like this game to have, like a Colorizer that Minecraft has. That was fun decompiling and sifting through.
